title: PAC Learning to Sample: On Computational Aspects of Language Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The success of language models has motivated theoretical work on learning to sample from distributions on discrete domains. A prominent abstraction is the model of language generation in the limit, introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan (NeurIPS 2024), in which the algorithm must generate from the target language after some finite but unspecified number of positive examples. While its positive results are surprisingly general, most guarantees are qualitative. In this work, we seek quantitative guarantees on sample and time complexity, inspired by statistical and computational learning theory. translated_title: PAC学习采样：论语言生成的计算复杂性
translated_abstract: 语言模型的成功推动了从离散域分布中学习采样的理论研究。一个重要的抽象模型是由Kleinberg和Mullainathan（NeurIPS 2024）提出的“极限语言生成”模型，其中算法必须在经过有限但未指定数量的正例后从目标语言中进行生成。虽然该模型的积极结果出奇地具有普适性，但大多数保证都是定性的。在这项工作中，我们受统计学习理论和计算学习理论的启发，寻求关于样本复杂度和时间复杂度的定量保证。为此，我们研究了由De、Diakonikolas和Servedio（SODA 2015）在另一背景下提出的语言生成PAC模型，其中定义在{-1,1}^n上的布尔概念类C定义了目标语言：给定未知概念f ∈ C的均匀随机正例，学习者必须输出一个采样器，其输出……
tldr: 该论文将PAC学习框架与极限语言生成模型相结合，首次为语言生成任务提供了关于样本复杂度和时间复杂度的定量保证。
